column3: NASB renders “seat” as “chair” and the aorist “sat down” as “have seated themselves.”
NASB follows the critical text (“do and observe”); “they speak and do not act” becomes “they say things and do not do them.”
NASB follows the critical text with “tassels” (no “of their garments” in the critical text), yet adds “of their garments”; “to be seen” is rendered “to be noticed.”
NASB follows the critical text with a single “Rabbi” and adds “respectful” to “greetings.”
NASB follows the critical text with “Teacher,” without “the Christ.”
NASB renders “instructors” as “leaders” and adds “that is.”
This verse is absent from the critical text; NASB prints it in braces, following the Textus Receptus.
“Traverse” is rendered “travel around on,” and “twofold more” is “twice as much.”
NASB renders “greater” as “more important” and “is sanctifying” with the past “sanctified,” following the Textus Receptus wording; the critical text has the present.
NASB renders “gift” as “offering” and “is bound” as “is obligated.”
NASB follows the critical text without “fools and”; “gift” is rendered “offering.”
“The weightier matters” is rendered “weightier provisions”; NASB adds “the others.”
NASB includes “and of the dish,” a Textus Receptus phrase.
